rationale: Y independently surfaces the T2VA coverage-regression thread that dominates the human comments (three separate validation updates about the tightened/failing T2VA gate), credits the workdir-arg removal explicitly, and its frame-count-mismatch finding echoes the ground-truth 'test tests itself' critique — hitting more of what reviewers actually cared about. X is equally well-grounded and more rigorously validates the rank-0/hang fix precisely (matching the most severe inline comment) but otherwise misses the weak-test and dead-arg threads and treats the T2VA deletion as a neutral fact rather than a flagged concern. Both are highly actionable with concrete file:line evidence; Y's numbered fixes include runnable code snippets, giving it a slight actionability edge, while X's tighter evidentiary style gives it a precision edge that doesn't fully offset its lower recall.
